description: Federated LoRA training delta submitted by a smartphone / browser contributor for a single baien training round. Per ADR-2605242600. Append-only TID-keyed; one record per (actorDid, baseModelCid, iter). The aggregator (40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/baien_federated_aggregator) subscribes to the firehose, verifies the ES256 signature against the member's passkey-derived key, re-runs `charter_rider.scan()` on the dataset shard, applies Wellbecoming + Byzantine + DP gates, then merges accepted deltas into the bf16 master. R0 scaffold — aggregator is import-time-failing until Council attestation activates it.

actorDid.description: DID of the member who performed the training step. MUST be an Adherent SBT holder; aggregator rejects non-SBT submissions per ADR-2605242600 G7.

baseModelCid.description: IPFS CID of the frozen BitNet trunk + frozen modality encoders the device trained on. Round-pinned (G10): if this differs from the aggregator's current round base, the delta is invalid.

datasetShardCid.description: IPFS CID of the training-data shard. Resolved via com.etzhayyim.substrate.datasetPin. The aggregator re-runs charter_rider.scan() on this shard before accepting; the device's `scannerPass` is a self-attestation, not the ground truth.

prevAdapterCid.description: IPFS CID of the adapter the device started from (chain-of-revisions, replay defence). For iter=0 this is the empty-adapter CID.

deltaCid.description: IPFS CID of the safetensors blob containing (A_after - A_before, B_after - B_before) for every LoRA-trainable layer (q_proj / k_proj / v_proj / o_proj only).

iter.description: Monotonic round counter per (actorDid, baseModelCid). Aggregator enforces strict monotonicity to defeat replay.

stepCount.description: Number of micro-batch=1 training steps performed locally. Cap enforces the per-round work bound; calibrated to iPhone 12 / Android 4GB / WASM-32 budgets.

deviceClass.description: Device profile used by the aggregator to weight trust priors only. Never used to gate participation — all three classes are first-class contributors per ADR-2605241900 edge invariant.

lossBefore.description: Mean eval-microbench loss BEFORE training, scaled by 1000000 (six decimals of precision; AT Protocol Lexicon v1 forbids float types, so units are 'micro-loss'). Wellbecoming gate (G8) compares lossAfter * 100 >= lossBefore * 98.

lossAfter.description: Mean eval-microbench loss AFTER training, scaled by 1000000 (same units as lossBefore). Aggregator discards deltas where lossAfter * 100 >= lossBefore * 98 (no improvement).

gradNormL2.description: L2 norm of the on-device DP-clipped delta, scaled by 1000000 ('micro-norm' units). The clip threshold tau and the Gaussian noise sigma are applied on-device before this field is recorded. Aggregator rejects deltas with gradNormL2 outside the calibrated band.

scannerPass.description: Self-attestation that the device successfully ran `charter_rider.scan()` on the full dataset shard with <=5% rows dropped. If false, the contributor SHOULD NOT have submitted the delta; aggregator verifies.

trainedAt.description: Wall-clock UTC timestamp at the device when training completed. Informational; aggregator uses iter + prevAdapterCid for ordering.

sig.description: ES256 signature over the canonical JSON of all preceding fields, using the member's WebAuthn passkey-derived key (ADR-2605231525). Aggregator verifies against the DID's resolved key material; failure = reject.

notes.description: Optional contributor notes (device model, ambient temperature, etc.). Aggregator does not interpret semantically.

supersededByUri.description: When the contributor reruns the same iter (e.g. corrected data shard), the prior record is soft-superseded by pointing here. Aggregator MUST prefer the live record.
